articles.description: The value of the university endowment’s holdings in the Bitwise Solana staking ETF, Grayscale Ethereum staking ETF and BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin ETF dropped to about $12 million.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward revenue rises 17% as trading volume falls in Q2
articles.description: Payward grew revenue despite weaker crypto spot activity, as funded accounts jumped 42% and a growing share of revenue came from outside transaction-based activity.

articles.title: Tokenization stocks slip as SEC delay puts 'speed bump' in crypto’s Wall Street push
articles.description: Bullish, Coinbase, and Circle were among the names lower on Friday after the regulatory setback.
